# Notices

Minicharts is April Zhu's own work: the pen, the colour wash, the drawing kit, the 54 example drawings and the page.

- The exploded-view conventions are adapted from diagram-design by Cathryn Lavery (MIT),
  https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design.
- The list of chart types follows Neon Diagrams (April Zhu).
- Two public algorithms appear in the engine: the Catmull-Rom curve (`spline`) and the mulberry32 random generator (`seedWith`).
- Fonts load from Google Fonts at view time: Young Serif, Gaegu and DM Sans (SIL Open Font License). They are not bundled.
